title: Netavark: drop `*config.Config`, introduce `PestoClient` for port forwarding
body:
Replace the stored `*config.Config` field with a `pestoBinary` string resolved once at init, and introduce a `PestoClient` struct in the pasta package to bundle binary path and socket path. A lazy `pesto()` factory method on `netavarkNetwork` constructs the client on demand, simplifying all call sites.
    
Fixes: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/podman/issues/28774

<!--- Please read the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/containers/container-libs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) before proceeding --->

comments.body: (I’d also like to push back a bit against the _general principle_ of alphabetically sorting fields … and we especially don’t want third-party contributors sending PRs to “clean up code” based on a supposed precedent.)
@Luap99 and @mtrmac, I have dropped `*config.Config` from `netavarkNetwork` struct.
